github_reconciliation.pr020_exact_head_ci: NOT_RUN; no PR has been created.

implemented: Discovers same-origin <link rel=alternate> RSS, Atom, JSON Feed and JSON links; orders JSON ahead of feeds and excludes other origins.
Validates bounded RSS/Atom and JSON Feed payloads, at most 2 MB and 1000 entries; rejects DTD/entity declarations and requires a title plus destination URL for each posting.

When no ATS match is established, immediately fetches one supported same-origin feed, validates its format and automatically persists a company job source with URL, strategy, confidence, timestamps and discovery origin.
Detected ATS evidence keeps precedence over generic RSS/JSON fallback; feed discovery preserves candidate homepage domain evidence without marking it verified.
limitations: Immediate RSS/Atom and JSON Feed rows are normalized and persisted as canonical jobs, application routes, raw posting snapshots, and (when a profile is supplied) explainable skill-mention matches. The fixture acceptance proves two employer feed jobs enter the profile job list without aggregator records; it does not yet exercise a complete aggregator-trigger-to-production-feed flow.
Vendor-specific public ATS JSON APIs, structured HTML fallback and general source-adapter scheduling are not implemented here.
Automatic source enrollment is validated only for synthetic same-origin fixtures; no live employer site or ATS endpoint was contacted.
REQ-070..073 remain PARTIAL because provider-specific public ATS endpoint precedence/scheduling and the full aggregator-trigger-to-feed-only-job acceptance path are not yet proven.
